question: Which of the following state governments in its budget for 2020-21 announced the 'Orunodoi Scheme'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Assam governments** in its budget for 2020-21 announced the 'Orunodoi Scheme'.
 
• ‘Orunodoi’ or Arunodoi Scheme is a new scheme of the Government of Assam.
 
• It was launched on 2nd October 2020.
 
• Under this, monetary benefits have been envisaged for more than 24 lac poor households in the state.
 
• This scheme will provide Financial Assistance of Rs 1000 per month through Direct Benefit Transfer to around 19.10 Lakh Families in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Assam:

 
 
• Chief Minister - Hemant Biswa Sarma
 
• Governor - Jagdish Mukhi
 
• Number of districts - 33
 
• Lok Sabha seats - 14.
 
• Rajya Sabha Seats - 7.
